terminal_report_handoff.sole_caller: revenue_desk_call_worker retry_scan mode in the existing RevenueDeskCallJobs Function Job pool
terminal_report_handoff.trigger: after exact terminal call/event/notification settlement materializes a pending sync_report_summary row, and on each bounded one-minute retry scan while that row is pending, processing, or reconciliation_required
terminal_report_handoff.scan_bound: at most five report-summary operations per retry_scan; provider event and notification work retains its separate bound
terminal_report_handoff.durable_evidence: exact CRMBillingOperations OPERATION_KEY, OPERATION_FINGERPRINT, ACTION, CRM_DEAL_ID, SOURCE_ENVIRONMENT, OPERATION_PAYLOAD_JSON, OPERATION_VERSION, CREATED_AT, and UPDATED_AT readback

request.route: existing crm_billing_orchestrator Advanced I/O route only

authentication: Catalyst Development API Gateway ZCFKEY, which may be common across Development projects and is never the sole authorization factor
the private action-scoped header whose worker CRM_BILLING_SHARED_HEADER_VALUE equals orchestrator REPORT_SUMMARY_HEADER_VALUE
terminal_report_handoff.least_privilege: the report credential cannot authorize prepare_paid_subscription or reconcile, and the paid caller credential cannot authorize sync_report_summary
terminal_report_handoff.timeout_and_body_bound: single end-to-end timeout of at most 5000 ms through response-body completion; application/json only; response body at most 4096 bytes
terminal_report_handoff.replay: the consumer atomically claims pending or reclaims only a processing report_claim pre-write row by OPERATION_VERSION; after exact report_write_started readback, processing or reconciliation_required never causes a second CRM write and converges only through exact Deal readback
terminal_report_handoff.terminal_transition: completion and containment compare expected ROWID, STATUS, LAST_OUTCOME, and OPERATION_VERSION, increment the version, and require exact readback; one bounded retry accepts only cursor advancement with unchanged status/outcome, never a semantic conflict; after observing the operation cursor, every transition to completed and every completed replay fresh-reads the authoritative Deal account, deployment/configuration binding, and exact patch; mismatch or unavailable readback CAS-keeps or demotes reconciliation, and stale containment that observes a winning completion gets one fresh read plus at most one repair CAS
terminal_report_handoff.deal_status_boundary: only an unreviewed Live Test_Status may receive a differing terminal patch to Completed; Completed is exact-replay-only, and Failed, Rolled Back, reviewed, or accepted evidence is moved to reconciliation_required without an automatic overwrite
terminal_report_handoff.success_readback: HTTP 200 with report_summary_readback_confirmed plus CRMBillingOperations STATUS completed and LAST_OUTCOME report_summary_readback_confirmed
terminal_report_handoff.readiness_gate: deployment REPORT_RECONCILIATION_STATUS remains Pending until exact Analytics evidence and the completed CRM operation are read back
terminal_report_handoff.post_handoff_owner: a human CRM operator may invoke the valid Complete Free Test Blueprint transition after exact summary readback; Results_Review_At remains human-only
